What are some common attributes used in HTML links?

The target attribute specifies where to open the linked document. Common values include _blank, _self, _parent, and _top. The base path attribute specifies the base URL for relative links. The href attribute specifies the URL of the linked document.
How can I create a download link in HTML?
To create a download link in HTML, you use the <a> tag with the href attribute set to the URL of the file you want to download, and the download attribute set to the desired filename.
What is the purpose of the download dialog box in HTML?

The download dialog box is a security feature that prompts the user to confirm whether they want to download a file. It helps prevent malicious scripts from automatically downloading files without the user's consent.
